test_title: PYST 20: SSC MTS - Reasoning (Held on: 22 Oct 2021 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Which of the following figures can be removed so that all, starting from I, fit into a pattern?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ae285cd4eb45ceb8a83b5058578b85a23f83add86f4bce9bb766c52acb07fbc5.png]
solution:
The logic followed is:

i) In the 1st, 2nd and 4th figures, the plus sign (+) is shifting next box in each figure.

ii) In the 1st, 2nd and 4th figures, the minus sign (-) is shifting next top box (moving clockwise direction) in each figure.

iii) In the 1st, 2nd and 4th figures, the divide sign (÷) is shifted next 2 steps in anticlockwise direction,

Thus we are getting I figure to II figure, II figure to III figure and IV figure to V figure but not getting III figure to IV figure.

Thus the image 1st, 2nd and 4th images are similar.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c1c2d35bd3bf82847172884d011771cece0dded06677101b4fb52884d9ca4723.png] 

Except for the third, all the others are following the pattern to their next image.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**
